title: anthyllis vulneraria f. nivalis
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria f. nivalis, commonly known as Snowy kidney vetch, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Fabaceae. The health benefits of Snowy kidney vetch include its ability to support kidney function, reduce inflammation, and act as a diuretic, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as kidney stones and urinary tract infections. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Snowy kidney vetch, such as anthylline and vulpinic acid, have been shown to contribute to its therapeutic effects.
